-- go.mod --
module example.com/mayyield

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import "example.com/mayyield/lib"

//go:wasmimport env blocky
func blocky()

//go:wasmimport gojs runtime.nanotime1
func nanotime1() int64

//go:noinline
func via(f func() int) int { return f() }

//go:noinline
func doblock() { blocky() }

//go:noinline
func nilderef(p *int) int { return *p }

//go:noinline
func usenil(p *int) int { return nilderef(p) }

//go:noinline
func condnil(p *int) int {
	if *p > 0 {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

//go:noinline
func leaf2(x int) int { return x + 1 }

//go:noinline
func bigframe(v int) int {
	var buf [8192]byte
	buf[0] = byte(leaf2(v))
	buf[8191] = byte(v >> 8)
	return int(buf[0]) + int(buf[8191]) + leaf2(v)
}

//go:noinline
func usebig(v int) int { return bigframe(v) }

//go:noinline
func usepure(x int) int { return lib.Pure(x) }

//go:noinline
func usesleepy(x int) int { return lib.Sleepy(x) }

//go:noinline
func usenano() int64 { return nanotime1() }

//go:noinline
func plainyield() int {
	c := make(chan int, 1)
	c <- 1
	return <-c
}

//go:noinline
func withdeferyield() (r int) {
	defer func() { r += 1 }()
	c := make(chan int, 1)
	c <- 1
	r = <-c
	return r
}

func main() {
	println(via(func() int { return 3 }))
	doblock()
	x := 7
	println(nilderef(&x), usenil(&x), condnil(&x))
	println(bigframe(x), usebig(x))
	println(usepure(3), usesleepy(4))
	println(usenano())
	println(plainyield(), withdeferyield())
}

-- lib/lib.go --
package lib

import "time"

//go:noinline
func Pure(x int) int { return x*2 + 1 }

//go:noinline
func Sleepy(x int) int {
	time.Sleep(time.Duration(x))
	return x
}

-- zw/go.mod --
module example.com/zerowire

go 1.27

-- zw/main.lgo --
package main

type ZeroEmpty struct{}

type ZeroHolder struct {
	Items []ZeroEmpty `json:"items"`
}

//go:noinline
func zeroenc(v ZeroHolder) ([]byte, error) { return v.MarshalBinary() }

//go:noinline
func zerodec(b []byte) (ZeroHolder, error) {
	var v ZeroHolder
	err := v.UnmarshalBinary(b)
	return v, err
}

func main() {
	b, err := zeroenc(ZeroHolder{})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	v, err := zerodec(b)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	println(len(v.Items))
}
